approaches_tried.approach: site_a_anchor_line() returning value via $(...) command substitution with fail() called inside the function on the non-unique branch
approaches_tried.reason: $(...) runs the function in a subshell; the in-function fail() call's echo to stdout got captured into the return value instead of updating the shared PASSED/FAILED counters, corrupting the line-number variable with failure-message text and producing a bash arithmetic-syntax error downstream. Caught by the phase's own mutation test (duplicating an anchor in a scratch copy).
